TUI RESULT: the real pure-Rust Chirp shell RENDERS Bob's notes. Per your decision tree, that means the bug is DEVICE-FFI-SPECIFIC (Android JNI / iOS Swift), NOT NMP and NOT the pure-Rust shell. I proved the full pure-Rust path end-to-end at chirp master's pinned NMP rev (fa49d00c — the exact device rev):

1. REAL C-ABI + compose + difference + decode (NEW test I added: `crates/nmp-app-chirp/src/ffi/tests/home_feed_pull.rs::chirp_difference_home_feed_surfaces_followed_author_notes`). It: `nmp_app_chirp_register` (full `compose_chirp_runtime`) → `sign_in(ALICE)` → seed store with Alice's kind:3 following Bob + Bob's 3 kind:1 notes (NO mute) → open the EXACT `Difference(active_user().follows(), list_members(ACTIVE_MUTE))` RootIndexed home feed through `nmp_app_open_feed` (JSON-marshaled FeedParams, the device path) → `decode_op_feed_snapshot`. PASSES — all 3 of Bob's followed non-self notes surface. So the C-ABI, JSON marshaling, compose, difference resolution, pull, and decode ALL work in the real shell.
2. RENDER half proven by the shell's own existing tests: `apps/tui/src/app/dynamic_feed_tests.rs:122` applies a home-feed frame under `CHIRP_TIMELINE_HOME_KEY` and asserts it renders into `state.rows` (`apply_nmp_event` → `SharedSnapshot::from_transport_payload` → `apply_feed_snapshot` → rows). Green.
3. EMISSION half proven earlier: the engine emits the frame carrying the cards with an advancing env.rev.

So engine → C-ABI → compose → difference → decode → render all work in pure Rust. The tui would show the cards.
 [...] <teammate-message teammate_id="chirp-account-trigger" color="blue" summary="chirp#39 CLOSED — feed renders on device, PR #45">
chirp#39 is genuinely closed, device-verified. PR: https://github.com/pablof7z/chirp/pull/45

**Report evidence (before/after screenshots + root-cause writeup): https://claude.ai/code/artifact/c56d702d-ac70-42b7-a649-55ccc309e777**

## What happened
1. Rebased a fresh worktree (`chirp-repin-projrev-fix`) onto latest origin/master — picked up the parallel regression-guard PR (a19687d, NMP#2944/chirp#39 test coverage) with no conflicts.
2. Re-pinned every `nostr-multi-platform` git dep from `fa49d00c5` to `83e888144` in Cargo.toml + regenerated Cargo.lock.
3. Built, seeded a fresh `nak serve` relay with signature-verified events (A's kind:3/kind:0/kind:10002, B's kind:0 + 3 kind:1 notes — all confirmed via `nak verify`), signed in on `nip55_test_avd` by **importing A's existing nsec** (not create-account).
4. First pass: app crashed with `UnsatisfiedLinkError` on `nativeResolveRef` the moment I navigated to Timeline. Traced it: `KernelBridgeRefs.kt` declares `nativeResolveRef`/`nativeReleaseRef` externs, but `nmp-chirp-android-ffi` never implemented the JNI side — a genuinely **pre-existing, never-before-exercised Chirp bug**. It only crashed now because a card was *finally* about to render and mount a `NostrAvatar`, which calls `resolveProfile` → `nativeResolveRef`. Every prior test had 0 cards, so this dead code path never fired.
5. Fixed it: the generic C-ABI (`nmp_app_resolve_ref`/`nmp_app_release_ref`) already existed and already backs iOS's equivalent calls — I just added the missing JNI wrappers in `claims.rs`, mirroring the existing `nativeClaimEvent`/`nativeReleaseEvent` pattern. Confirmed the symbols now link (`nm -D` shows both exported).
6. Reinstalled, redid the full sign-in → Timeline flow: **rev 26 · 3 cards**, all of B's notes rendering with content/timestamps/relay-provenance, no crash, account stable. Confirmed reproducibly across repeated checks.
7. Ran the regression guards from a19687d against the re-pin — both `chirp_difference_home_feed_surfaces_followed_author_notes` (Rust) and `OpFeedDecoderTest`'s live-path cases (Android) pass.
8. Opened PR #45 with the fix + before/after evidence, "Closes #39".

## Minor note (not blocking, not investigated further)
Two of the three rendered rows show B's raw shortHex pubkey instead of the resolved "Bob Test" display name (only one row resolved it) even after the crash fix and a few seconds' wait. Feels like a per-row profile-cache/dedup quirk rather than anything related to the reversion or empty-feed root causes — flagging in case it's worth a follow-up issue, but didn't chase it since it's cosmetic and outside this task's scope.

This closes out the full chirp#39/#40 chain: account-reversion (PR#42), bridge soundness (proven, NMP#2944 filed), and now the actual render fix (PR#45, re-pin + JNI wire-up), all device-verified.
</teammate-message> [...] ## Secondary real finding (file if you want, not the symptom)
The difference composition FAILS TO OPEN before an active account exists: `ScopeNotSupportedYet { scope: "ListMembers-active-mute-no-active-account" }` (nip51_sources.rs:130-132, mute source is RequireActive). Plain follows opens fine pre-login (AllowMissingActive) and just shows empty. So the Rust shells that open the home feed with the difference scope get a hard open-error if they open before sign-in, whereas iOS/plain-follows degrades gracefully. This is a Chirp-composition fragility, not the empty-feed symptom (the device DID open + emit a snapshot).
 [...] - (b) difference resolves acquisition empty/wrong with unresolved mute: absent mute → `muted_pubkeys()` empty → admission `lp && !rp` = `lp` (permissive). Tests 1–5 all have absent mute and surface the notes. (The only real mute-difference defect is NMP#2930: it hard-ERRORS pre-login, but post-login — the device state — it's fine.)
- (c) pull-window only admits live post-open events, not already-stored: refuted by tests 2, 3, and 5 — the pull recovers already-stored notes for the difference composition, including cold-start with no relay.
